optical-courier.witness: one bit from an authored optical or tactile cue changes reachable delivery time
optical-courier.limit: no independent non-radio source or field evidence

continuous-brake.witness: physical stop and service bounds separate on the same latency variation
continuous-brake.limit: 1-D authored plant, supports neither broad estimator faults nor field assurance

event-envelope.witness: actual travel, shared capacity and report custody consumed in a deterministic source trace
event-envelope.limit: development geometry and scoped simulator; no independent mission

contingent-fallback.witness: physical mating and source ticket enable additional work, old use retained, later fault assessed
contingent-fallback.limit: exploratory grouped mechanism, direct cached baseline ties; not full joint architectural superiority

charged-observation.witness: failed probe leaves cleanup duty, actual battery use and controlled evidence timing
charged-observation.limit: synthetic acquisition source and finite family; cannot establish nonindependent supplier measurement

residual-occupancy.witness: equal receipt with late old physical effect produces changed exclusion; sharp horizon declaration
residual-occupancy.limit: single future launch and restricted old occupations; not per-platform validation

joint-risk.witness: fixed hidden dependence and exposure distinctions alter risk admission
joint-risk.limit: declared exact synthetic laws, not calibrated prevalence or per-actor trustworthy sensing

settlement-history.witness: source-scoped actual release, admissible restart and duplicate/replay distinctions
settlement-history.limit: valid effect-side certification premised; no general receipt validation through split or hidden authority changes

strategic-preparation.witness: lawful refusal, shadow price and fallback staging consumption differ from faults
strategic-preparation.limit: declared compliant private-information two-owner game; no field or faulty-signer treatment

native-blocked-source-and-notice.witness: same physical failure is delayed or suppressed at the scheduler; after reassignment a failed carrier can still park on the only shelf, or still owe a delivery if the new plan had kept its duty; a declared finite timely-report family meets the native station service cut
native-blocked-source-and-notice.limit: single authored order on original pinned 7x11 motion and item plant, with a common injected notice law; no duplicate/asymmetric reports, cross-fleet assignments, held-out mechanism, or claim of tolerance outside the tested family

coherent-clock.witness: With a common offset, individually possible timestamp pairs cannot all occur in one complete assignment; allowing an unmatched transfer defeats physical release on the same readings.
coherent-clock.limit: Authored bounded clock and matching model, not a hardware clock or all dropped-record conditions.

held-command-viability.witness: The robot can remain inside the wedge for the held-command interval yet enter a state from which collision is unavoidable. A distinct continuous proof checks stopping viability.
held-command-viability.limit: Authored wedge dynamics and declared actuation; not general collision avoidance or empirical containment.

platform-effect-seam.witness: Selected Navigation2 code distinguishes docking success from named current and action termination from issuing zero velocity; source checks and a separate stop model preserve the actual-effect boundary.
platform-effect-seam.limit: Compiled local source seams only; no ROS/deployment, named stop instrument, egress proof or platform-level effectiveness claim.

ordered-inventory-repair.witness: A full shelf guard loses useful service in some matched native warehouse runs; first settling a held order item frees a real carrier without adding a spare, but finishes later.
ordered-inventory-repair.limit: Authored finite scenarios on one native order plant; no general prevalence or repeated-starvation claim.

release-sampling-and-cascade.witness: Indistinguishable current booking and holding records hide whether the idle clock sampled an older visit. On joined selected source, resulting release order changes service at a second handler; modeled physical vacancy must still be earned.
release-sampling-and-cascade.limit: Controlled callbacks and in-process delivery; actual ROS timing, motion, faults and independent accepted transfer remain unvalidated.

paired-attempt-debit.witness: The failed early send can still spend budget. Testing it in isolation and testing a late send in isolation does not establish that the pair can run. Copied bytes, a restored path, and delivery events differ.
paired-attempt-debit.limit: Selected source and authored readout cuts; no accumulated lifetime debt, full network simulation, or independent transfer claim.

paid-read-before-fallback.witness: A stationary read with ambiguous output spends one tick needed for fallback. Equal aggregate acoustic metrics need not preserve branch identity or show on-time availability.
paid-read-before-fallback.limit: Frozen corridor development model and synthetic channel counterexample; no live acoustic decode or independently selected mission.

changing-expiry-predicates.witness: Two exact fixed-law profiles conceal an old expiry that matters after a lawful partner-enabled transition. Serial refusals give interval constraints; indivisible checks need joint refusal evidence.
changing-expiry-predicates.limit: Authored authorization and finite selected port model; no claim of actual signer security, physical port behavior or independent transfer.

ambiguous-source-and-reserve.witness: Two standby paths can share a base supply; controller restart or an inactive label can hide a still-live physical duty or unresolved persistent fault.
ambiguous-source-and-reserve.limit: Synthetic typed plants and a separate label-preparation audit; the dataset is not a recovery evaluation.

independent-bridge-proof-check.witness: An independently selected bridge preserves a receiver proof without changing the receiver; one more tick breaks the authorization check. A factored direct proof obtains the same service with fewer obligations.
independent-bridge-proof-check.limit: Constrained early v0.5 model; does not stand in for independent v0.3.1 architecture, service gain or broad proof superiority.

anonymous-referent-and-settlement.witness: Identical anonymous tracks and feasible identity sets do not settle the live load when a cart swap can occur after the old settlement record.
anonymous-referent-and-settlement.limit: Exact authored depot histories, not a native tracker run or a measured rate of identity reassignment.

scope-held-through-commit.witness: Pinned warehouse and radio replays each preserve an older staged effect while directing the rescue away from the held footprint; a changing footprint breaks that use of the old observation.
scope-held-through-commit.limit: Adapter controls its own staged submission. The same-information direct policy ties. No broad native cancellation or physical clearance guarantee.

missing-first-settlement-receipt.witness: For the declared prefix-gated transfer protocol, one delayed first receipt can prevent further issues for an arbitrarily long period despite most physical supports being empty.
missing-first-settlement-receipt.limit: Evidence for starvation in that protocol under unbounded receipt delay. Other legal issue policies and useful work outside those rights were not ruled out.

retry-uses-live-debit.witness: The same failed early send can consume or preserve real sender allowance in the pinned SubT fixture. If it charges, the later attempt that would succeed alone exceeds the unreplenished window budget.
retry-uses-live-debit.limit: Two slots and rolling communication allowance only. It does not measure battery, thermal endurance or a long-run recovery rate.

clock-read-estimate-age.witness: The pinned LinuxPTP replay distinguishes a new ingress stamp with an older offset from a fresh source-identified notification. A separate rate law is needed to bound offset at an earlier acquisition.
clock-read-estimate-age.limit: Selected software methods, inert hardware and transport. Not a measured drift or timestamp delivery guarantee.

partition-mule-staging.witness: In a declared partition, a producer, base and alternative suppliers lack different evidence. Preserving the old report and starting some silent preparation changes whether a second route fault misses the deadline.
partition-mule-staging.limit: Source-informed deterministic development plant, not a NeBula network run or an independently tested one-way protocol.

ariac-overlapping-expiry.witness: Selected native expiry code can set a healthy flag while a separate admitted occurrence is still active; the switcher consumes the health flag on the tested cut.
ariac-overlapping-expiry.limit: The source prefix stops before the original expiry loop erases a record. It proves neither a live Gazebo publication nor a physical arm state.

door-read-versus-hold.witness: Native replays separate checking an expected door leaf, holding a supervisor session, and keeping the close version across retirement.
door-read-versus-hold.limit: Selected simulator and supervisor methods. No healthy transport reordering or field door motion is asserted.

stable-held-site-inspections.witness: The admissible footprint sets are replayed from both held-source fixtures. A modeled observation budget separates inference from fresh verification and a joint constraint changes the useful inspection depth.
stable-held-site-inspections.limit: Inspections and the cross-source dependence are declared above the adapters. No native inspection timing or independent integrated transfer.

braking-cutoff-mission-risk.witness: Continuous physical clearance gives an exact last usable report. Known versus unknown overlap with earlier failures and common versus separate randomization change the modeled mission risk.
braking-cutoff-mission-risk.limit: One-dimensional authored plant with exogenous reports and fixed source laws. No measured threat coupling or field reliability.

new-formation-bounds.witness: Exact one-state constraints can compose into a new unsafe stopping requirement; the reused profile exposes the affected partners without rechecking every robot pair.
new-formation-bounds.limit: Scalar common-limit model, exact simultaneous state snapshot. No stochastic source, authority transfer, or actual mission.

map-rollout-crossed-with-allocator-chang.source: PR #526 (Mixed_Map_And_Role_Cuts.tex); contextual premise pinned to VDA 5050 2.1.0
map-rollout-crossed-with-allocator-chang.witness: An authored map-version rollout and allocator reassignment agree on the latest active map and role but disagree on the still-occupied route. A fixed rescue uses a different site on the retained old route in the two histories.
map-rollout-crossed-with-allocator-chang.limit: Modeled rollout, map-dependent path binding and physical clearance. The pinned specification supplies update and coordinate distinctions, not stock behavior of a robot under these joint changes.

adapter-frame-capture-and-curve.witness: Pinned source callback replays distinguish captured transform from current state. The same callback gives the node in local coordinates and passes through world curve data; a modeled pending curve needs an interior, not just endpoint, revalidation.
